name: SPAL USA
old_description: SPAL USA is the North American subsidiary of SPAL Automotive Srl and has been supplying products from Italy since 1989. The company's sales and distribution center is currently located in a 40,000-square-foot facility in Ankeny, Iowa. From this location, SPAL USA provides customized systems, components and service for OEM and aftermarket applications.
about:
SPAL USA, the North American subsidiary of Italy's SPAL Automotive Srl, has operated from Ankeny, Iowa since 1989. The company runs a 40,000-square-foot sales and distribution center that supplies cooling components and customized systems to OEM and aftermarket customers across the continent.

The facility stocks and supports a full line of thermal-management products manufactured by its parent company: brushed and brushless axial fans, brushed and brushless centrifugal blowers, and brushless coolant pumps. These components feature IP68 and IP6K9K sealed motors, integrated EMC filtering, and smart controls such as PWM, CAN, and LIN interfaces. SPAL USA adds value by configuring these building blocks into application-specific cooling packages for vehicles and stationary equipment.

The customer base spans on- and off-highway markets. In the automotive sector, SPAL USA serves car, bus and coach, powersport, and truck OEMs. It also supplies agriculture and construction machinery builders, mobile refrigeration units, oil-cooling systems, and a range of stationary industrial applications. Both original equipment manufacturers and aftermarket distributors rely on the Ankeny center for technical support and rapid fulfillment.

SPAL Automotive Srl brings more than 60 years of design and production experience to the partnership. The group's stated mission is to deliver the highest-quality cooling products through continuous R&D investment and tight control over every manufacturing step. That heritage, combined with local inventory and engineering support, is what SPAL USA presents as its differentiator in the North American market.
